{{Taurus}}
Taurus 7 is the 147th day of the year in the [[Gaian calendar]]. It is the 7th day of Taurus, and it is a Sunday. It corresponds to ISO week 21, weekday 7.

Its informal Japanese name is 6宮7日.

On this day, [[Gaiad chapter 147|Chapter 147]] of the [[Gaiad]] is read.

To see structured data on this date see {{q|Q152167}}.
